title.zh: Bitcoin and ether holders urged to enter ‘bunker mode’ against possible AI attacks
title.en: Bitcoin and ether holders urged to enter ‘bunker mode’ against possible AI attacks

current_state.zh: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake urged crypto holders to enter 'bunker mode' and migrate funds to addresses whose public keys have never appeared onchain, warning that AI could break the cryptography securing Bitcoin and Ethereum wallets 'in months, not years,' while Vitalik Buterin cautioned that rushed migrations could cause losses.
